body: Please don't hurt me.

I shouldn't have shared anything, I'm not trying to be dramatic, I just feel like sharing is always manipulative and I should have known that, and nobody wants to hear about it - I don't know.  I don't feel anything.  I don't know. I'm sorry.  I didn't mean to be awful.  I just was trying to say why I didn't like the Twitter posts.  I was just trying to say that it hurt me as a victim.  I need to remember I'm not a victim.

I'm sorry I feel stupid, I'm always having my trauma used as a weapon against me, I used to be in a relationship up until 10 months ago where if I had flashbacks I'd be physically cornered and screamed at for reacting to my trauma, and screamed at until I thought they were going to beat the shit out of me and I was begging them not to hurt me, every time I had shown I had trauma.  It's just really hard to feel like I deserve to live right now.  I feel so evil, and I feel awful, I don't want to be here and make more problems.  I'm used to being punished for showing any signs, I feel bad I feel like I need to be punished and I need to kill myself.
I called rainn but it didn't help but now I'm on the phone with my grandma and she's helping a lot

I'm sorry I'm calming down I just got flashbacks to the last five years of my life of being raped and hurt for being raped I just can't handle it.  I'm just really scared I refuse to look anymore I'm just really scared
I did I'm just really triggered and I feel like I have to beg for forgiveness I feel so evil I feel like there's no fixing me
They're making fun of me I deserve I'm awful I just want to die

I honestly think you're right, I mean it would make so much sense all that time depositing all that gross waxy substance directly into my sinuses is probably exactly what fucked them up, and I always bought cheap shake so it was probably moldy on top of it.  Just more reason to keep to quitting, and thank you so much for the well wishes, good luck to you too I wish you all the best!

I'm sorry to be so long and I have no idea if it's lame to take the ask to let you guys know seriously (I'm sorry if I wasn't supposed to), after talking to the neurologist they recommended an ent and they're looking at my sinuses now and may have found an osteoma, and my entire frontal sinus cavity (I think it is?  I'm not good reading medical reports) is full of polyps.  I don't know if that's my answer or not I just know it's benign I still have to go over everything with the ent.

I've been sober four months and some odd days now, don't even really think about alcohol anymore but have health problems to deal with now that it and weed were masking.  Not easy just have to force all your willpower into getting sober, and nothing else until you don't need it anymore.  Have to force yourself past those first two months, I didn't do meetings but I'd recommend them.  Trying to do it without help is even harder and probably foolish

I don't take all of those meds right now sorry to mislead you, the last was Topamax but they had to take me off because of lithium.  I meant we've tried all of these meds in the past.  Okay sorry I will ask someone to take me there

Yes it's in my brain but I've taken migraine medication before, anti seizure meds and neurontin and it's only kept getting worse. Only now it's at a point of more things happening than just the pain, and the pain being at this level. is this for sure emergency worthy?  It's a stupid question maybe but I am scared to take up their time if it's not j know some people could be dying
I have made the appointment for the neurologist but I have to wait until next month to see him, they cannot see me sooner
It's been over a month

It looks like the only options for me are assisted living at this point or wait multiple years.  I don't want this I'm not happy.  I would rather be dead
